stories.title: Indian students look abroad as domestic hiring stalls
stories.summary: Indian students face a 9.9% unemployment rate, rising to 13.6% in urban areas. With employers favouring candidates with one to five years of experience, freshers filled only 5% of manufacturing roles. Students are now exploring international postgraduate education as a route to career opportunities.

stories.title: IT degree enrolments drop as AI interest grows
stories.summary: The number of students signing up for information technology degrees has plunged following the rise of artificial intelligence. Graduates who enrolled during the previous IT boom are now less likely to be in full-time work shortly after finishing their studies. The market is adjusting its expectations.

stories.title: International business student decline threatens UK economy
stories.summary: International business school enrolments have fallen by 18% since their 2022/23 peak, following tighter immigration measures. A report by London Economics warns this decline could cost the UK economy £4.2 billion and 32,300 jobs. The sector is currently navigating the impact of new visa restrictions.

stories.title: UK business schools predict continued enrolment downturn
stories.summary: Seven in ten UK business schools reported lower international enrolments for the 2026/27 academic year. Government policies are cited as the primary barrier to recruitment, with 60% of institutions expecting further declines by January 2027. The sector is preparing for a sustained period of reduced international interest.

stories.title: Global survey shows shift in student destination preferences
stories.summary: Universities in the big four nations report declining international postgraduate enrolments due to restrictive government policies. A survey of 400 universities found that students are increasingly choosing institutions in Asia and continental Europe instead. Visa constraints are now the single biggest obstacle to global student recruitment.

stories.summary: With Cambrian College projecting a deficit of $1.7 million for the current 2026-2027 school year, the college is developing a five-year deficit recovery plan. That’s according to the board’s 2027-2028 budget development framework document, which was approved by the college’s board of governors Nov. 11.

stories.title: Quebec universities report second year of enrolment declines
stories.summary: International student numbers in Quebec have fallen by 12%, representing 5,900 fewer students this fall. Universities are raising concerns about the impact on research and academic programs. One administrator noted that the region's growth is now tied to its ability to retain international talent.

stories.title: US, UK see sharp fall in international student enrolments amid visa curbs: Survey
stories.summary: Universities in the United States and the United Kingdom are facing a decline in international undergraduate enrolments as students increasingly consider destinations in Asia and continental Europe, according to a global survey of higher education institutions. stories.title: Visa barriers drive students to Asia and Europe
stories.summary: International student numbers in the US and UK fell by 13% and 19% respectively, according to a survey of 437 universities. Processing delays and tougher screening are pushing students toward institutions in Asia and Europe. National policies are now the primary factor shaping student destination choices.

stories.title: Gunjan wins historic boxing gold at Youth Olympics
stories.summary: Gunjan became the first Indian woman to win a boxing gold medal at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics. The 17-year-old secured the women's 48kg title after defeating Algeria's Bouthaina Bensalah by unanimous decision. Her victory contributed to India's two-medal haul in the boxing ring.

stories.title: Vivaan Kapoor secures Olympic quota with silver medal
stories.summary: Vivaan Kapoor won a silver medal in the men's trap event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha. The 24-year-old's podium finish secured an Olympic quota place for India at the 2028 Los Angeles Games. He narrowly missed the gold after a shoot-off against Kuwait's Abdulrahman Alfaihan.

stories.title: Neeraj Kumar earns bronze and 2028 Olympic quota
stories.summary: Indian shooter Neeraj Kumar won bronze in the men's 50m rifle 3 positions event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha. His performance secured a quota place for India at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The 26-year-old finished with 346.5 points in the final.

stories.title: Peruvian student wins gold at Astronomy Olympiad
stories.summary: Dhamaris Alarcón won the gold medal at the Latin American Astronomy and Astronautics Olympiad in Paraguay. The 16-year-old student previously took silver in Brazil last year. She continues to distinguish herself in international science competitions while completing her secondary education.

stories.title: Turkmen students win at World Olympiad for Young Physicists
stories.summary: Students from Magtymguly Turkmen State University secured the Grand Prix and five medals at the 2026 World Olympiad for Young Physicists in Bali. Musa Artykov took the top individual prize. The university reported the results following the competition, which concluded on November 9.

stories.title: Civics Bee offers Maryland students scholarship prizes
stories.summary: The American Cornerstone Institute is hosting a Little Patriots contest for Maryland K-5 students. The program offers scholarships reaching $100,000 for participants. Finals will be held in Washington, and the deadline for entries is December 15. The institute was founded by Ben Carson.

stories.title: Carrollton High School students nominated for Governor’s Honors
stories.summary: Fifteen students from Carrollton High School have been nominated for the 2027 Governor’s Honors Program. The four-week residential summer program targets gifted juniors and seniors. Nominees were selected following an extensive application and interview process to represent the school at the state level.

stories.title: Hall County Schools selects nominees for Governor’s Honors
stories.summary: Sixty-one students from Hall County Schools have been named district nominees for the Georgia Governor’s Honors Program. The residential summer experience aims to provide academic and social enrichment for gifted students. It offers instruction designed to foster critical thinking and innovation on a college campus.

stories.title: ASU researchers visit French neutron facility
stories.summary: Arizona State University chemist Jason Khoury and doctoral student Jacob Fritsky recently visited the Institut Laue-Langevin in France. The facility is a center for neutron research. The trip aimed to study quantum materials that could influence future technology development.

stories.title: High school DNA experiment reaches research milestone
stories.summary: Pristine Onuoha won the 2022 Genes in Space competition while in high school. Her experiment, which monitors DNA changes in space, was launched to the International Space Station in 2023. The project has now been published as formal scientific research.

stories.title: RIT students win Microsoft hackathon
stories.summary: Five Rochester Institute of Technology students took first place at the LEAD Aspire 2026 hackathon in New York City. The team developed a strategy to improve trust in AI-powered shopping agents. They were selected from over 1,000 applicants to compete in the final round.

stories.title: Hyderabad student builds offline satellite receiver
stories.summary: Aagam Jain of Indus International School has developed a satellite receiver named SummitSathi. The device uses readily available components to provide weather information in areas without internet access. Three units are planned for deployment across 10 villages in Himachal Pradesh.

stories.title: EPFL launches Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence
stories.summary: EPFL has introduced a new Bachelor degree in Artificial Intelligence. The program aims to provide students with the mathematical and computational foundations required to design intelligent systems. It will also cover the ethical and societal implications of AI technology.

stories.title: Student argues for teaching study skills in schools
stories.summary: A student essay suggests that schools focus on subject matter while neglecting evidence-based learning strategies. The author notes that many students lack training in memory, attention, and stress management. The piece argues that teaching these skills early is necessary for academic success.

stories.title: Educator suggests normalizing productive struggle in science
stories.summary: One educator suggests that science anxiety may stem from a focus on finding a single correct answer. The approach advocates for normalizing productive struggle to encourage experimentation and exploration. The goal is to shift student focus away from the pressure of immediate accuracy.

stories.title: AI tools in classrooms require teacher oversight
stories.summary: Research published in AI, Brain and Child suggests that AI educational tools rely on active teacher scaffolding rather than frictionless operation. The study tracked classroom interactions and found that digital interfaces often obscure the need for instructors to manage technical glitches and communication breakdowns.

stories.title: Pearson official discusses AI in assessment
stories.summary: Sarah Hughes of Pearson stated that AI should only be used in testing when it adds value or increases validity. She noted that the company uses AI for fluency and pronunciation tasks. The primary question remains whether AI provides genuine improvement or merely cost savings.

stories.title: Harvard education official calls AI use an experimental moment
stories.summary: Jeffrey James Curley of the Harvard Graduate School of Education described current student AI usage as an experimental wild West moment. A survey indicated that 85 percent of college students use large language models. No research-backed consensus on usage exists four years after ChatGPT debuted.

stories.title: RMO 2026 exam scheduled for November 15
stories.summary: The Regional Mathematical Olympiad 2026 is set for November 15 from 1 PM to 4 PM. Qualified students must register online to download their admit cards. No registration fee is required, though students who fail to register will not be permitted to take the exam.

stories.title: Odisha announces math scholarship test dates
stories.summary: The Board of Secondary Education in Odisha has released the schedule for the Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Test 2026. The exam identifies students with mathematical talent. Online registration opens November 12 and closes November 22 at 11:45 PM.

stories.title: Academy of Horse Breeding of Turkmenistan hosts Olympiad
stories.summary: The Academy of Horse Breeding of Turkmenistan is hosting an Economics Olympiad. The event aims to identify talented students. Further details regarding the competition and registration requirements are available on the official website. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: BBOSE releases December 2026 exam schedule
stories.summary: The Bihar School Examination Board has released the timetable for the Bihar Board of Open Schooling and Examination December 2026 session. Class 12 theory exams begin December 9, followed by Class 10 on December 15. Both will be held in two shifts. The calendar is now available online.

stories.title: Applications open for NNPC and TotalEnergies scholarship
stories.summary: Applications are open for the 2026 to 2027 NNPC Limited and TotalEnergies National Merit Scholarship. The programme offers financial support to first and second year Nigerian undergraduates at accredited universities. It is part of a corporate commitment to supporting education and human capital development in the country.

stories.title: Government invites applications for SC student scholarships
stories.summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is accepting applications for the Top Class Education Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students. Selected applicants receive 86,000 rupees in their first year and 41,000 rupees annually thereafter. The scheme covers tuition, institutional charges, and living expenses for students at selected institutions.

stories.title: UGC opens postgraduate scholarship applications
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has opened applications for the National Scholarship for Postgraduate Studies for the 2026 to 2027 academic year. Selected students receive 15,000 rupees per month for ten months annually. The total financial assistance reaches 3 lakh rupees over two years for those meeting renewal requirements.

stories.title: India AI Fellowship 2026 to 2027 launched
stories.summary: The Government of India has launched the India AI Fellowship under the IndiaAI Mission to support student innovation. The initiative offers financial assistance to engineering students developing technological solutions. It aims to provide pathways to premium career opportunities across industry and research domains for the next generation.

stories.title: California promotes CalKIDS college savings program
stories.summary: California has invested more than 2.4 billion dollars in CalKIDS Scholarships. State Treasurer Fiona Ma stated the program gives families something tangible to build educational plans around. Scholarships are automatically established for eligible children, allowing families to start planning for college or career training before the senior year.

stories.title: Scholars4dev lists international scholarships for US study
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of scholarships for international students in the United States. With private college tuition often exceeding 60,000 dollars annually, the site highlights government and university programs. Each listed entry covers at least half of tuition costs, with many providing full funding for students.

stories.title: Scholars4dev tracks Canadian scholarships for international students
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of scholarships for international students in Canada. Annual tuition for a Bachelor degree often ranges from 30,000 to 40,000 Canadian dollars. The site lists programs that cover at least half of tuition, noting that Canada offers fewer scholarships than the US or UK.

stories.title: French government offers scholarships for foreign students
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of French scholarships for international students. While public university tuition remains low at 200 to 600 euros, private institutions can charge 10,000 euros. The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship, developed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, remains a primary tool for attracting foreign students.

stories.title: List of international scholarships for women released
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has published a list of international scholarships for women pursuing research and higher education. The awards cover fields including science, business, and health. Some entries are fully funded while others provide partial support. The list includes the AAUW International Fellowships for non-US citizens.

stories.title: Scholars4dev highlights prestigious international scholarships
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of prestigious scholarships for international students for the 2027 to 2028 cycle. The selection includes government programs and awards at leading universities. Most of the listed opportunities are fully funded for students who demonstrate high levels of motivation and academic talent.

stories.title: Merit-based scholarships for international students listed
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of excellence scholarships for international students. These merit-based awards are granted for academic results, leadership, or other achievements. The list features programs from governments and universities globally, with most offering full funding for the brightest and most talented applicants.

stories.title: Global government scholarships for international students updated
stories.summary: Scholars4dev has updated its list of foreign government scholarships for international students. The programs aim to support development in partner countries and attract talent to local universities. The list covers opportunities from the US, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Asia, most of which are fully funded.

stories.title: RRB ALP CBT 1 answer key released
stories.summary: The Railway Recruitment Boards have released the answer key for the Assistant Loco Pilot recruitment examination. Candidates who took the test between November 3 and November 5 can access their responses and question papers online. Objections to the provisional answer key may be submitted until November 19.

stories.title: BTEUP releases odd semester admit cards
stories.summary: The Board of Technical Education Uttar Pradesh has released admit cards for the 2026 odd semester and special back paper examinations. Students can access their hall tickets through the official portal using their enrollment number. The document is required for entry into the examination hall.

stories.title: Andhra University releases semester results
stories.summary: Andhra University has declared results for various undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including BA, BSc, and MA. The results cover semester examinations conducted in July 2026. Students can access their scorecards through the university website by entering their examination credentials and are advised to retain a copy.

stories.title: CISCE announces ICSE 2027 exam dates
stories.summary: The CISCE has released the date sheet for the 2027 ICSE Class 10 examinations. Testing begins on February 15 with English Paper 1 and concludes on March 31. Every paper is scheduled to start at 10:15 AM. The first exam is 95 days away.

stories.title: India Post releases Tamil Nadu merit list
stories.summary: The Department of Posts has declared the result for the Tamil Nadu Circle Postman and Mail Guard examination. The merit list follows a competitive exam held in July and a skill test in September. The final vacancy count includes 197 Postman posts and 5 Mail Guard positions.

stories.title: AIIMS releases CRE-5 PST results for group codes 53 and 28
stories.summary: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences has released Physical Standard Test results for Group Codes 53 and 28 under its 2026 recruitment examination. Candidates can access the result documents on the official portal to verify their qualifying status by searching for their individual roll numbers.

stories.title: KEA extends Karnataka NEET PG choice-filling deadline
stories.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority has extended the deadline for postgraduate medical candidates to confirm seat choices and pay fees until November 13. While 3,268 candidates were allotted seats in the first round, 164 individuals have yet to exercise any of the available options.

stories.title: KMAT 2026 admit cards available for download
stories.summary: The Karnataka Private Postgraduate College's Association has released admit cards for the November 14 management aptitude test. Candidates must download and print the document from the official portal, as digital copies on mobile devices will not be accepted for entry into the examination centre.

stories.title: CISCE publishes ICSE Class 10 date sheet for 2027
stories.summary: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations released the ICSE Class 10 timetable on November 10. The schedule provides the full list of theory papers, session timings, and reporting instructions for the upcoming board examinations. Students can track all updates via the official council notification portal.

stories.title: ISRO releases answer key for scientist and engineer recruitment
stories.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation has published the provisional answer key for its 2026 scientist and engineer recruitment test. Candidates may submit objections regarding the October 29 examination through the online portal until 1 PM on November 15. The space agency is currently reviewing the responses.

stories.title: NPTEL releases October 2026 semester results
stories.summary: The National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning has released examination results for the July-December 2026 semester. Students across disciplines including engineering, management, and social sciences can download their scorecards from the official website by entering their roll numbers and other required details.

stories.title: ICSI to declare CSEET October 2026 results on November 15
stories.summary: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India will release the Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test results for the October session on November 15 at 2 PM. Candidates can access their performance data and e-Result-cum-Marks Statements through the official website using their login credentials.

stories.summary: The Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan has launched an AI-integrated Vidya Samiksha Kendra to monitor student attendance, academic performance, and infrastructure across its network. stories.summary: The Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan ( KVS ) has launched three digital initiatives aimed at strengthening school administration, improving parent-teacher communication, and building stronger connections with former students. stories.title: Ho Chi Minh City introduces AI education
stories.summary: Ho Chi Minh City is implementing AI education for general students starting in the 2026 to 2027 academic year. Officials acknowledge the city faces six major bottlenecks regarding teacher capacity, infrastructure, and official guidelines. The curriculum rollout is currently being tested at select schools for the gifted.

stories.title: Babcock University partners with Cavista for AI training
stories.summary: Babcock University has signed a memorandum of understanding with Cavista Technologies to provide practical AI training for undergraduate students. The programme targets 300 and 400 level students, offering industry immersion and mentorship to supplement classroom theory. The goal is to prepare students for careers in the technology ecosystem.

stories.title: UNESCO trains Oyo teachers on AI and digital pedagogy
stories.summary: UNESCO has commenced a three-day training programme for 52 master trainers in Oyo State, Nigeria. Funded by the European Union, the project aims to strengthen digital competence and artificial intelligence skills among educators. The training is being held at a community ICT centre in Ibadan.

stories.summary: The American Federation of Teachers and its New York City affiliate have signed a legally binding agreement with Anthropic to enforce safety, privacy, and transparency standards in schools. The pact applies to districts using Claude for Teachers. The unions say the agreement makes these standards enforceable across thousands of schools.

stories.summary: The California Federation of Teachers has asked Governor Gavin Newsom to impose a three-year moratorium on generative AI tools in kindergarten through eighth grade classrooms. The union cites concerns regarding student and teacher safety, specifically referencing the documented use of student search data for third-party recruitment purposes.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu trains teachers on climate change
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu has trained 2,000 government teachers across 22 districts under a new climate education programme. The state intends to train 4,000 teachers by December, using 20 climate literacy modules covering heat, water, waste and biodiversity. The curriculum is intended to introduce climate education in government schools.

stories.title: TSC prepares teachers for competency-based curriculum
stories.summary: The Teachers Service Commission will begin specialised training for teachers in Creative Arts, Music, Dance, Theatre, Film and Media Technology on November 23. The commission says the training is necessary to prepare staff for the demands of the Competency-Based Education curriculum, which requires new teaching approaches.

stories.title: Quebec school staff suspended after locker incident
stories.summary: Four school staff members have been suspended following reports that students were confined inside a locker at a school in the Laurentians. Quebec's education minister condemned the practice as unacceptable, stating that his office is in contact with authorities to investigate the highly problematic disciplinary measures.

stories.title: Saanich girls school receives 22 million dollar gift
stories.summary: St. Margaret’s School has received a 22-million-dollar anonymous donation to support campus improvements and a new health and wellness centre. The school says the facility will focus on the well-being of students and staff. No design details or specific locations for the new building have been announced.

stories.title: Hong Kong proposes teacher certification bill
stories.summary: The Hong Kong government has introduced the Education Amendment Bill 2026, which proposes mandatory practising certificates for all teachers. The bill includes safeguards to prevent individuals convicted of national security offenses from teaching. Certificates will be valid for up to three years, contingent on professional development requirements.

stories.title: Schools across Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by hoax threats
stories.summary: Hundreds of schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland were evacuated on Wednesday following a wave of hoax bomb threats. Police confirmed that approximately 1,000 schools in Scotland and 300 in Northern Ireland received the generic warnings. Authorities have reassured parents that the threats are bogus.

stories.title: Ho Chi Minh City to survey English proficiency of preschool staff
stories.summary: Ho Chi Minh City will conduct a comprehensive survey of English proficiency for all administrators, teachers and staff at preschools during the first semester of the 2026-27 academic year. The department requires all staff to undergo the assessment as part of a plan to introduce English to children.

stories.title: Malaysia tightens international student screening
stories.summary: Malaysia is enforcing stringent screening for international students to ensure only qualified candidates are accepted. The Higher Education director-general stated that emphasis is placed on cumulative grade point average and English proficiency to safeguard the quality of the nation's higher education and prevent students from becoming a burden.

stories.title: Malaysia tightens screening of foreign students to protect higher education standards
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 12 , The admission of international students to higher education institutions (HEIs) in the country continues to be subject to a stringent screening process to ensure that only qualified candidates are accepted, thereby preventing them from becoming a burden to the nation.

stories.title: Odisha chief minister awards education incentives
stories.summary: Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi inaugurated the Suravi-2026 children's festival in Bhubaneswar this week. During the event, he presented education awards to 375 individuals and institutions. The government has provided over 1.38 billion rupees in award incentives to support students and educators across the state.

stories.summary: Srinagar, Nov 11: The School of Education, Central University of Kashmir (CUKashmir), celebrated National Education Day 2026 by organising a panel discussion on “Priorities of Higher Education in India in the Light of NEP-2020 Recommendations” at its Tulmulla campus on Wednesday. stories.title: NCERT reimagines teacher training for NEP 2020
stories.summary: NCERT and SCERT Delhi hosted a five-day Reimagined NISHTHA programme to align teachers with NEP 2020 goals. The initiative aims to enhance pedagogical skills and improve school education quality through dedicated resource persons under the Samagra Shiksha framework. The policy goals remain under active implementation.

stories.title: Saurabh Sehgal on education innovation
stories.summary: Saurabh Sehgal, director of Sapphire International School, is recognised for work in digital transformation and future-ready learning. He has participated in forums including the Edu Visionary Summit and the Viksit Bharat Roundtable 2047. His efforts focus on integrating technology with pedagogy to develop scalable educational models.

stories.title: Teachers union hosts LGBTQ breakfast
stories.summary: New Jersey teachers attended two days of professional development that included a breakfast co-hosted by the union and its Rainbow Alliance Committee. A slide presented at the event listed items for each day of the week, including brunch, tacos, and days described as super gay.

stories.title: Students discuss public broadcasting history
stories.summary: Jan Prasar celebrated Public Service Broadcasting Day by honouring Usha Mehta, who ran an underground radio station during the Quit India Movement. The event also marked the anniversary of MK Gandhi's 1947 broadcast to refugees. School students joined the discussion on the values of public service broadcasting.

stories.title: Bengaluru metro expands with Pink Line stretch
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate a 7.5-km elevated stretch of the Pink Line on November 13. The route opens to the public on November 14, bringing the total network to 103 km. Five trains will operate at eight-minute intervals to provide relief along Bannerghatta Road.

stories.title: Search launched for missing police officers in Kishtwar
stories.summary: Two Special Police Officers, Rashpal Kumar and Bobby Chand, have gone missing in the Dachhan-Marwah area of Kishtwar. A search operation is underway following the incident. This follows a separate attack on a CRPF checkpoint in Kulgam district where three personnel were injured by unidentified attackers.

stories.title: Missing officers found dead in Kishtwar
stories.summary: Two Special Police Officers, Rashpal Kumar and Babi Chand, were found dead in the Dachhan-Marwah area after going missing on Wednesday. Their service weapons were missing, and officials are investigating the circumstances of the deaths. The officers were attached to the Special Operations Group.
